# bestflats.vip

> Luxury short-stay rental platform. Public residences are browsable and bookable
> end-to-end, and are exposed to AI agents via the Universal Commerce Protocol
> (UCP/1.0) with AP2 (Agent Payments Protocol) payment mandates, settled in USDC.

## Public pages
- [Home](https://www.bestflats.vip/)
- [Collections (all residences)](https://www.bestflats.vip/collections)
- [Residence detail](https://www.bestflats.vip/apartment?id=ID) — replace ID with an apartment id or slug
- [Availability calendar](https://www.bestflats.vip/calendar?apartmentId=ID)

## For AI agents (agentic commerce)
- Catalog (JSON): https://api.bestflats.vip/apartments
- UCP discovery (UCP/1.0): https://api.bestflats.vip/ucp/discover?capabilityHash=rental-listing-v1
- UCP item detail: https://api.bestflats.vip/ucp/item/UCP_ID
- Agentic checkout (AP2 mandate, admin/agent): POST https://api.bestflats.vip/ucp/checkout
- Discovery manifest: https://www.bestflats.vip/.well-known/ucp.json
- Service health: https://api.bestflats.vip/health

## Notes
- Listing data is public and machine-readable; prices are quoted in USDC for agent negotiation.
- Creating bookings or completing checkout requires authentication (guest session) or an
  AP2 payment mandate. Browsing and discovery do not.
- Contact: concierge@bestflats.vip
